rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and technical education—areas where JD's 404s and web3 builder community could benefit from clearer, more accessible onboarding and content. While JD is focused on surfacing real builders in India's web3 ecosystem and pushing back against hype, Lydia's track record of translating complex technical concepts (JavaScript, Claude Code, web performance) into visual, in-depth content could help distinguish genuine builders from mediocre projects through better technical storytelling and DX strategy.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet JD — you both care deeply about separating real technical work from hype, and Lydia's background in developer experience and visual technical education could sharpen how 404s communicates builder quality in web3.
